title: Time-sensitive operation suppression gated only in C (spec 09 14.6 constrained node)
description: Spec 09 14.6 R-09-132: nodes without a valid wall clock MUST NOT originate time-sensitive operations (scheduled check-in, message TTL requiring wall-clock comparison). Classification: divergent (partial). Evidence: C gates DTN ops (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:73 if (!lichen_wall_clock_valid())) and slot coordination (coap_slot_coord.c:1499). Rust production paths: no wall-clock gating found for scheduled check-in or TTL comparisons. Python: link/slot_coordination.py has no wall-clock gate (rg clean); no test pins scheduled-check-in suppression or TTL gating in any stack. Suggested placement: rust/lichen-node + python node loop - gate check-in origination and TTL-consuming operations on wall_clock_valid; add a constrained-node vector or test pinning suppression (cf. test/vectors/constrained_node_time.json).
